mapper.sql: (SD.ShipCancelRqstDate IS NULL OR SD.ShipCancelRqstDate = '') AND (SD.ShipCancelCmpletDate IS NULL OR SD.ShipCancelCmpletDate = '')
mapper.select:
SELECT SD.OrderNo AS orderNo, SD.OrderProdNo AS orderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo AS orderChangeNo, SD.ChnlOrderNo AS chnlOrderNo, CAST(O.OrderReciptDate AS CHAR) AS orderReciptDate, SD.OrderName AS orderName, SD.ProdCode AS prodCode, SD.ProdName AS prodName, SD.ItemName AS itemName, SD.ProdQty AS prodQty, SD.SalePrice AS salePrice, SD.NvPrice AS nvPrice, SD.RecverName AS recverName, SD.RecverPhoneNo AS recverPhoneNo, SD.RecverMobileNo AS recverMobileNo, SD.RecverZipcode AS recverZipcode, SD.RecverAddr AS recverAddr, SD.OrderMemo AS orderMemo, SD.DeliMemo AS deliMemo, SD.BuyPrice AS buyPrice, SD.DeliFeeAmt AS deliFeeAmt, SD.DeliFeeType AS deliFeeType, SD.OrderState AS orderState, SD.ShopName AS shopName, Ch.ChnlName AS chnlName, CAST(SD.ShipCheckDate AS CHAR) AS shipCheckDate, IFNULL(SD.ShipPlace, '기본출고지') AS shipPlace, IFNULL(SD.BundleYn, 0) AS bundleYn FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON SD.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON SD.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON SD.ShopCode = S.ShopCode
ORDER BY IFNULL(SD.ShipPlace, '기본출고지'), SD.BundleYn DESC, SD.RecverAddr, SD.RecverName, SD.ProdName, SD.OrderNo, SD.OrderProdNo, SD.OrderChangeNo LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON SD.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON SD.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON SD.ShopCode = S.ShopCode

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shopwizard.tShpShipDirectPrint SD INNER JOIN shopion.tOrdOrder O ON SD.OrderNo = O.OrderNo INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpChnl Ch ON SD.ChnlCode = Ch.ChnlCode INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON SD.ShopCode = S.ShopCode
SELECT ShopName FROM shopwizard.tCmpShop WHERE ShopCode = #{shopCode}
